info.title: One Piece: Un tesoro grande un sogno
info.synopsis: A bordo di una nave pirata Zap e i suoi sottoposti hanno appena rapito tre ragazzi che li potranno condurre ad un favoloso tesoro. La maggiore dei tre, Amanda, sente due pirati lamentarsi di Zap e gli propone di fuggire tutti assieme. I due accettano e fuggono portando con sé i tre su una scialuppa. Un mese dopo la ciurma di Rufy raggiunge l'isola…

info.title: Noble Reincarnation: Born Blessed, So I'll Obtain Ultimate Power
info.synopsis: Noah si reincarna nel tredicesimo principe della famiglia imperiale, e sin da subito si rende conto della sua posizione e di alcune straordinarie abilità, tra cui quella di avere un potenziale pressoché infinito.

episodes.title: Il tredicesimo principe imperiale Noah Ararat
episodes.synopsis: Noah rinasce come tredicesimo principe imperiale e si ritrova a vivere una vita completamente nuova.

episodes.title: La nascita di una diva
episodes.synopsis: Noah viene colpito dal talento di una giovane cantante e decide di aiutarla.

episodes.title: Guadagni e perdite
episodes.synopsis: Il governatore di Holjoy si rivolge a Noah per riuscire a ottenere i fondi che spettano alla regione.

episodes.title: La rivolta di Almeria
episodes.synopsis: Noah è alle prese con la rivolta scoppiata nel suo feudo.

episodes.title: Le persone sono tesori
episodes.synopsis: Grazie alla selezione del cavaliere Noah acquisisce un nuovo sottoposto prezioso.

episodes.title: Nubi nere
episodes.synopsis: Noah, che ora ha 12 anni, rimane coinvolto nei traffici del primo principe Gilbert.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: 法務省大臣として初仕事をするノア。法に公平に、と省内をまず変えていくノアの裏で謀反をたくらむ皇太子・アルバートが暗躍する。しかし、策に失敗した皇太子一派。捕縛していた法務省に口封じのため賊たちが侵入し、ノアに襲い掛かる。

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: ノアは宝物庫で魔剣と同じく、精霊の「ルティーヤ」を手に入れる。ルティーヤを魔法の力で顕現させると、実体を持ち現れた。レヴィアタンも同じく顕現させ、戦わせることでレベルを上げることに成功した。ノアはさらに強くなるため他の魔道具を探し始める。

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Noah catches a spy in the act and learns of a plot against the emperor's life.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: The emperor suggests a potential wife for Noah: the granddaughter of his uncle, Indra the Lightning Prince.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: The emperor makes the decision to disinherit the crown prince... but not before seeking Noah's advice.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Noah catches Albert in the act of attempting a coup and gives him one last chance to repent.

info.title: Kill Blue
info.synopsis: Jūzō Ōgami è un leggendario sicario che non ha mai fallito una missione, per quanto impossibile potesse sembrare. Un giorno, dopo aver eliminato una potente organizzazione, viene punto da una misteriosa vespa e perde conoscenza. Al suo risveglio, il temibile assassino trentanovenne si ritrova trasformato in un ragazzino di 13 anni! Prima ancora di riuscire a capire cosa sia successo, il suo capo gli affida un nuovo incarico: "Infiltrati in una scuola media con quel corpo." Quello che lo attende è una vita scolastica del tutto inaspettata, piena di compagni eccentrici, caos adolescenziale e pericoli in agguato. Riuscirà Jūzō a tornare alla sua forma originale? O gli assassini che gli stanno dando la caccia metteranno fine alla sua seconda vita prima ancora che inizi davvero!?

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Mysteriously transformed in a kid, legendary hitman Juzo poses as a student to investigate a middle school. Later, he encounters a suspicious intruder.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Juzo discovers Mitsuoka Pharmaceuticals created the wasp and befriends the president's aloof daughter Noren. As he slowly befriends her, she's kidnapped.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Juzo turns to a classmate to catch up on his studies and joins the home economics club with Noren. Mitsuoka Pharmaceuticals makes a big announcement.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Juzo's cover as Noren's boyfriend comes under fire when a young assassin transfers in and challenges Juzo to a duel in a bid to become Noren's fiancé.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: While on an errand, the Home Economics Club runs into Tenma, a brash multi-sport ace who challenges Juzo to a futsal match. Will Juzo take him on?

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Juzo and Tenma’s futsal showdown begins. With his astonishing physical ability, Tenma overwhelms the Home Ec Club team of Juzo, Shin, and Kito. Sensing that Juzo is no ordinary opponent, Tenma drops the handicap and starts playing for real. Juzo and the others fight desperately to keep up with Tenma’s dominant performance, but how will the match end?

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Juzo and Noren end up on a double date with Chisato and Tenma. The four enjoy shopping and lunch, but the moment the movie starts, Juzo mysteriously reverts to his adult body! He rushes to the restroom, only for Noren to be kidnapped again. Chasing the culprit’s car to a stadium, Juzo and Tenma face Kazuma and Eiji Rindou, assassin brothers from the industry’s top organization, JARDIN.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Kazuma wields powerful hypnosis, while Eiji launches a brutal assault with explosive golf balls. They, too, are assassins chasing Mitsuoka Pharmaceutical’s secrets. Juzo struggles as Kazuma turns civilians against him. And Kazuma has already placed a certain hypnotic spell on Noren. To save her, Juzo races to her side...

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Juzo races to Noren’s side. Meanwhile, Tenma and Eiji clash in an outrageous soccer-vs.-explosive-golf battle. Tenma prepares to end the fight with a move he developed in practice. But at the end of the life-or-death struggle against Kazuma and Eiji, the unconscious Noren awakens, and the first thing she sees is...

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: After Kazuma’s hypnosis makes Noren fall deeply for Juzo, she launches an all-out attack on his heart. But when Juzo gently turns her down, she tries to jump from the roof! Desperate to undo the spell, Juzo takes Noren to meet Kazuma at an amusement park, only to end up alone with her on a Ferris wheel, where things take a dangerously romantic turn?!

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: With more assassins gathering at school, Ogami organizes the first-ever Hitman Summit in hopes of keeping everyone under control. However, the meeting quickly descends into chaos as the eccentric personalities clash. Meanwhile, a heated ramen challenge draws unexpected attention, and a mysterious girl makes a surprising appearance that may change everything.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Unicorn Mai Otohime is a marine-sports prodigy with expert-level ocean knowledge. She has come for a Mitsuoka Duel too, but her target is Juzo. This leads to Noren challenging Mai herself. As the duel nears, Juzo and the others face parent-teacher conferences and questions about their futures, leading Juzo to reflect on his school life, the friends he’s made, and the possibilities ahead.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: The students must climb a mountain within 24 hours during a blizzard, dodging two rival professors.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Shiki is caught in an avalanche while shielding Homare, who has injured her leg.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Homare and Shiki reach the summit, followed by Juji, Kuina, and Rokuro. Only Jin and Yaoroshi remain. As Yaoroshi lashes out at those around him, Jin points out that his impatience is causing trouble for his teammates. Just then, Nekosaki and Innami appear.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: The Oni Brigade operates independently, fighting the Momotaro without answering to any organization. Its general, Hayate Todoroki, arrives at Rasetsu Academy to recruit Shiki, a Child of Kishin. Shiki rejects Todoroki's invitation to join his campaign to wipe out the Momotaro, but Yaoroshi sympathizes with his cause and leaves with him.
